flags.message: The upstream supremecourt.gov snapshot (2026-11-03.json) lists LowerCourt as 'United States Bankruptcy Appellate Panel for the 10th Circuit' for LowerCourtCaseNumbers '(26-2404)', even though the application was submitted to The Chief Justice (Circuit Justice for the Fourth Circuit), the Virginia pro se applicant is litigating against an E.D. Va. Chapter 7 bankruptcy trustee (H. Jason Gold), companion application 26A657 (from No. 26-2406) lists the Fourth Circuit, and CourtListener confirms that No. 26-2404 is In re: Paul Schultz in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit (arising from E.D. Va. No. 1:26-cv-02804-LMB-IDD).
